accounts.name: Accounts Receivable
accounts.description: What customers owe us

accounts.name: Provision for Doubtful Debts
accounts.description: A credit balance against receivables: what is not expected to be collected

accounts.name: Payment Clearing Account
accounts.description: Collected but not yet in a bank account

accounts.name: Security Deposits
accounts.description: Rent, electricity and other deposits paid, recoverable when the arrangement ends

accounts.name: Loans & Advances (Asset)
accounts.description: Advances to staff and others, recoverable in cash or kind within the year

accounts.name: Input CGST (ITC)
accounts.description: Central GST paid on purchases, claimable against output tax

accounts.name: Input Cess (ITC)
accounts.description: Compensation cess paid on purchases; it can only be set off against output cess

accounts.name: GST paid on advances
accounts.description: GST paid when an advance for services arrived; cleared as the advance is applied to invoices

accounts.name: ITC reversed, reclaimable on payment
accounts.description: Credit reversed under Rule 37 because a supplier was not paid in 180 days; it comes back as they are paid

accounts.name: TDS Receivable
accounts.description: Tax customers deducted from our invoices, recoverable from the government

accounts.name: TCS Receivable
accounts.description: Tax collected at source by our sellers; claimed against our own income tax

accounts.name: Capital Work-in-Progress
accounts.description: Cost of assets being built or installed, held until they are put to use

accounts.name: Accumulated Depreciation
accounts.description: Depreciation charged so far; a credit balance that nets against the asset ledgers

accounts.name: Asset Disposal Clearing
accounts.description: Holds the sale value of an asset sold by invoice until its disposal is posted

accounts.name: Investments
accounts.description: Shares, bonds, mutual funds and deposits held for more than a year

accounts.name: Current Investments
accounts.description: Investments to be realised within twelve months

accounts.name: Miscellaneous Expenses (Asset)
accounts.description: Preliminary and pre-operative expenses not yet written off

accounts.name: Branch / Divisions
accounts.description: Inter-branch account; its balances across branches net to nil

accounts.name: Suspense Account
accounts.description: Holds an entry whose right ledger is not yet known. Should be nil before the books are closed

accounts.name: Accounts Payable
accounts.description: What we owe suppliers

accounts.name: Goods received, bill pending
accounts.description: The cost of goods received on a goods receipt note until the supplier's bill is entered

accounts.name: GST Payable under Reverse Charge
accounts.description: GST we owe on purchases where the supplier does not charge it. Paid in cash; input credit cannot settle it

accounts.name: TDS Payable
accounts.description: Tax withheld from vendors, owed to the government

accounts.name: PF Payable
accounts.description: Provident fund deducted and contributed, due to EPFO by the 15th

accounts.name: ESI Payable
accounts.description: ESI deducted and contributed, due to ESIC by the 15th

accounts.name: Professional Tax Payable
accounts.description: Professional tax deducted from salaries, due to the state

accounts.name: Labour Welfare Fund Payable
accounts.description: Employee and employer labour welfare fund contributions

accounts.name: Unearned Revenue (Retainers)
accounts.description: Advances taken for work not yet done

accounts.name: Salaries Payable
accounts.description: Net salaries for a posted payroll, until they are paid

accounts.name: Bank Overdraft / Cash Credit
accounts.description: Overdraft and cash-credit limits drawn; repayable on demand

accounts.name: Secured Loans
accounts.description: Term loans and other borrowings against a charge on assets

accounts.name: Unsecured Loans
accounts.description: Loans from directors, partners, relatives and others without security

accounts.name: Provisions
accounts.description: Expenses incurred and not yet billed or paid: audit fee, bonus, gratuity

accounts.name: Provision for Income Tax
accounts.description: Income tax for the year, net of advance tax once it is set off

accounts.name: Deposits Received
accounts.description: Security deposits taken from dealers, tenants and customers

accounts.name: Drawings
accounts.description: What a proprietor or partner takes out of the business; reduces their capital

accounts.name: Opening Balance Equity
accounts.description: Holds the other side of opening balances until the books are complete

accounts.name: Discount Allowed
accounts.description: Contra-income: reduces revenue rather than adding an expense

accounts.name: Discount Received
accounts.description: Cash and trade discounts given to us by suppliers

accounts.name: Profit on Sale of Fixed Assets
Foreign Exchange Gain
accounts.description: Gains on settling or restating foreign-currency balances

accounts.name: Employer PF, ESI and LWF
accounts.description: The employer contributions and PF charges on salaries

accounts.name: Staff Reimbursements
accounts.description: Expenses employees incurred for the business, repaid with salary

accounts.name: Gratuity
accounts.description: Gratuity paid or provided under the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972

accounts.name: Rounding Off
accounts.description: Absorbs the paisa lost when an invoice total is rounded to the rupee

accounts.name: Provision for Doubtful Debts (expense)
accounts.description: The charge, or release, as the provision is raised or lowered

accounts.name: Interest & Fees on Late Taxes
accounts.description: Interest and late fees on TDS, TCS and GST; not deductible for income tax

accounts.name: Composition Tax
accounts.description: Tax paid on turnover under the composition scheme; it cannot be collected from buyers

accounts.name: Depreciation
accounts.description: Charged under Schedule II of the Companies Act

accounts.name: ITC reversed on exempt supplies
accounts.description: The share of common credit that belongs to exempt supplies, reversed under Rules 42 and 43

accounts.name: Loss on Sale or Discard of Fixed Assets
Foreign Exchange Loss
accounts.description: Losses on settling or restating foreign-currency balances

accounts.name: Cash Short & Excess
accounts.description: Differences found when cash is counted: a debit is a shortage, a credit an excess
